summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing of quarterly financial results by Pharming Group N.V., a foreign private issuer, covering the first quarter of 2026. The filing includes revenue figures, product updates, and regulatory progress for its drugs RUCONEST and Joenja. There is no event that qualifies as a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard earnings release with no transaction or corporate action that triggers special-situation classification.
